General Requirements: All equipment must be new and of the manufacturer's current model in production at the time of each order executed over the life of the contracts resulting from this RFP.
All standard or optional equipment must be as advertised by the original equipment manufacturer (OEM) and must not consist of substitute or aftermarket equipment.
Equipment attachments or parts to be installed must follow the manufacturer's recommendations or standard industry practices.
Warranties shall become effective on the date the equipment is placed into service as agreed by Dallas ISD and the awarded vendor.
Warranties shall be equal to or exceed those offered to the general public.
Warranty service and repairs or replacements must be performed at no cost within five business days of the District reporting the issue to the vendor.
If the five business day repair period cannot be achieved, a temporary replacement device must be provided.
Vendor must maintain adequate stock of replacement devices and/or parts to ensure service within the repair timeframe.

Bid Summary: The Dallas Independent School District (Dallas ISD) is soliciting proposals under RFP JA-207652 (SOURCING #168884) for student and staff computing devices including laptops, desktops, tablets, monitors, and related accessories, with an anticipated contract term of three years plus two optional one-year renewals, totaling up to five years. The procurement is bond-funded and quantities are estimated over the contract life with flexible purchase volume and delivery starting September 2024, requiring vendors to provide white glove services including asset decaling, etching, and deployment coordination with Dallas ISD ED TECH. The award approach allows for single or multiple vendors on a line-item basis, with evaluation weighted on purchase price (40 points), vendor reputation (10 points), quality (15 points), district needs fit (15 points), MWBE participation (20 points), and other relevant factors, culminating in a best value award anticipated by August 2024 Board meeting. Addendum 1 clarified warranty terms requiring OEM-backed warranties of one year for student Chromebooks and three years for Windows laptops and staff devices, confirmed funding sources, delivery and deployment details, and submission requirements. Addendum 2 extended the proposal due date to July 9, 2024, 2:00 PM CST, without other changes. Vendors must acknowledge all addenda upon proposal submission.
